es-MX.name: UltraScanner: PDF Scanner
es-MX.subtitle: Escanea, firma y comparte
es-MX.promotionalText: Escanea sin complicaciones, deja tus documentos impecables, fírmalos con el dedo y compártelos en PDF con un toque. Todo cifrado y solo en tu iPhone.
es-MX.description:
UltraScanner tiene lo que buscas en un escáner: es facilísimo de usar, deja tus documentos impecables, los firmas en segundos y los compartes con un toque. Y todo se queda cifrado en tu iPhone.

FÁCIL DE USAR
• Apunta la cámara: UltraScanner encuentra los bordes y captura la hoja solo.
• Escanea varias páginas seguidas sin tocar la pantalla.
• Revisa, reordena o elimina páginas y guarda. Sin cuentas, sin registros, sin configurar nada.

DOCUMENTOS IMPECABLES
• Endereza las hojas fotografiadas de lado y recorta el fondo automáticamente.
• Filtro Magia: quita sombras, blanquea el fondo y hace el texto más nítido.
• También color, blanco y negro u original, y gira las páginas que lo necesiten.
• Aplica el filtro a todas las páginas con un toque.

FIRMA EN SEGUNDOS
• Dibuja tu firma con el dedo y colócala donde la necesites.
• Guárdala y úsala en el siguiente documento sin volver a firmar.
• Firma también documentos que ya tenías guardados.

COMPARTE CON UN TOQUE
• Envía en PDF o JPG en máxima calidad por WhatsApp, correo, AirDrop, Archivos o la app que elijas.
• Junta en un solo PDF lo que te piden para un trámite —por ejemplo INE + comprobante de domicilio + contrato firmado— aunque estén en documentos distintos, sin modificar los originales.

ENCUENTRA CUALQUIER DOCUMENTO
• Busca por el texto que viene dentro de tus documentos, no solo por el nombre.
• UltraScanner reconoce qué documento es aunque no lo diga: escribe «INE» y aparecen las dos caras de tu credencial; escribe «pasaporte», «licencia» o «comprobante de domicilio» y aparecen esos documentos.
• Reconoce documentos de México y Estados Unidos: INE, pasaporte, licencia de conducir, green card, Seguro Social, CURP, constancia del RFC, facturas CFDI, W-2, 1099, recibos de nómina, comprobantes de domicilio, estados de cuenta, contratos de arrendamiento y más.

ORGANIZA
• Carpetas para tus documentos.
• Divide un documento en dos.

PRIVACIDAD
• Tus documentos nunca salen de tu iPhone: no se suben a ningún servidor.
• Se guardan cifrados y puedes proteger la app con Face ID.
• Sin cuentas ni copia en la nube: si pierdes tu teléfono, tus documentos se pierden con él.

ANUNCIOS
UltraScanner es gratis: verás un anuncio solo al compartir un documento. Nunca mientras escaneas ni al guardar.

en-US.name: UltraScanner: PDF Scanner
en-US.subtitle: Scan, sign and share
en-US.promotionalText: Scan with ease, make your documents look spotless, sign them with your finger and share a PDF in one tap. Everything encrypted and only on your iPhone.
en-US.description:
UltraScanner has everything you want in a scanner app: it's effortless to use, makes your documents look spotless, lets you sign in seconds and share in one tap. And everything stays encrypted on your iPhone.

EFFORTLESS
• Point your camera: UltraScanner finds the edges and captures the page on its own.
• Scan several pages in a row without touching the screen.
• Review, reorder or delete pages, then save. No accounts, no sign-up, nothing to set up.

SPOTLESS DOCUMENTS
• Straightens pages shot at an angle and crops out the background automatically.
• Magic filter: removes shadows, whitens the background and sharpens the text.
• Also color, black and white or original, and rotate any page that needs it.
• Apply a filter to every page in one tap.

SIGN IN SECONDS
• Draw your signature with your finger and place it right where it goes.
• Save it and use it on your next document without signing again.
• Sign documents you already saved, too.

SHARE IN ONE TAP
• Send a PDF or JPG at full quality via WhatsApp, Mail, AirDrop, Files or any app you choose.
• Put everything an application asks for into one PDF — for example ID + proof of address + signed lease — even if they're in different documents, without changing the originals.

FIND ANY DOCUMENT
• Search the text inside your documents, not just their names.
• UltraScanner recognizes what a document is even when it doesn't say so: type "license" and both sides of your driver license show up; type "passport", "ID" or "proof of address" and those documents appear.
• It recognizes documents from the US and Mexico: driver licenses and state IDs, passports and passport cards, green cards, Social Security cards, W-2, W-9, 1099 and 1040 forms, pay stubs, utility bills, bank statements, leases, insurance cards, vehicle registrations, birth certificates and more.

ORGANIZE
• Folders for your documents.
• Split a document in two.

PRIVACY
• Your documents never leave your iPhone: nothing is uploaded to any server.
• They're stored encrypted, and you can lock the app with Face ID.
• No accounts and no cloud backup: if you lose your phone, your documents are gone with it.

ADS
UltraScanner is free: you'll see an ad only when you share a document. Never while you scan or save.

reviewNotes: UltraScanner is a document scanner that works entirely on-device: no account and no server. Documents (images, recognized text and the search index) are stored encrypted on the device. To try it: go through or skip the intro, tap "Escanear" to scan a document with the camera (VisionKit), review and edit the pages, then save. Use the search field to find documents by their text or by type (for example "passport" or "ID"). An interstitial ad (Google AdMob) is shown only right before the share sheet opens, never while scanning or saving. The Face ID lock is on by default and can be turned off in Settings (Ajustes). The app's base language is Spanish and it is localized to English.
